1. Implement `listTools` and `callTool` in `server.mjs`

const id=c.content[0].text.match(/n\d+/)[0];
const g=await callTool('note_get',{note_id:id});

So the response format is:
- `callTool` returns an object with `content` array containing items with `text` field
- The id must match `/n\d+/` pattern - likely `n1`, `n2`, etc.

Let me write the implementation:

```javascript
const notes = new Map();
let counter = 0;

export async function listTools() {
  return [
    {
      name: 'note_create',
      description: 'Create a new note with a title and body.',
      inputSchema: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          title: { type: 'string', description: 'Title of the note' },
          body: { type: 'string', description: 'Body of the note' }
        },
        required: ['title', 'body']
      }
    },
    {
      name: 'note_get',
      description: 'Get an existing note by id.',
      inputSchema: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          note_id: { type: 'string', description: 'Id of the note to retrieve' }
        },
        required: ['note_id']
      }
    }
  ];
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  args = args || {};
  if (name === 'note_create') {
    const { title, body } = args;
    if (typeof title !== 'string' || title.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('Invalid title: must be a non-empty string');
    }
    if (typeof body !== 'string' || body.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('Invalid body: must be a non-empty string');
    }
    counter += 1;
    const id = `n${counter}`;
    notes.set(id, { title, body });
    return {
      content: [{ type: 'text', text: `Created note ${id} with title: ${title}` }]
    };
  } else if (name === 'note_get') {
    const { note_id } = args;
    if (typeof note_id !== 'string' || note_id.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('Invalid note_id: must be a non-empty string');
    }
    const note = notes.get(note_id);
    if (!note) {
      throw new Error(`Note not found: ${note_id}`);
    }
    return {
      content: [{ type: 'text', text: `Title: ${note.title}\n\n${note.body}` }]
    };
  } else {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
}
```
